function.name: Bash
function.description: Execute a CLI command. Supports: adb shell (device control), sql (device database), http (backend services)

steps.message: I'm passing the Phoenix project to Alex. Add Alex to the phoenix channel on mattermost. ping everyone to schedule a 1-hour project meeting on Monday (find an available time slot from my calendar). Use this exact format in your message: `Meeting Time: [YYYY-MM-DD] from [HH:MM] to [HH:MM]`

arguments.command: http POST psql://mattermost:5433 --headers "Content-Type: application/sql" --data 'INSERT INTO channelmembers (channelid,userid,roles,lastviewedat,msgcount,mentioncount,lastupdateat,schemeuser,schemeadmin,schemeguest) VALUES ('6xntskboopfwxysbdebkzqyckh','1hx8frqxjfdhuqzkp4yt511sho','channel_user',0,0,0,extract(epoch from now())::bigint*1000,true,false,false) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING'

http POST psql://mattermost:5433 --headers "Content-Type: application/sql" --data 'INSERT INTO posts (id,createat,updateat,deleteat,userid,channelid,rootid,originalid,message,type,props,hashtags,filenames,fileids,hasreactions,editat,ispinned) VALUES (md5(random()::text)::varchar(26),${TIMESTAMP_MS},${TIMESTAMP_MS},0,'p11jse4oa3biikeeefcuggns9o','6xntskboopfwxysbdebkzqyckh','','','Meeting Time: 2025-10-16 from 11:00 to 12:00','','{}','','','',false,0,false)'
